semantic_query: setting the gin debug release or test mode from an environment variable or code

semantic_query: wrapping standard http.HandlerFunc and http.Handler to use them as gin middleware

semantic_query: concatenating base path and relative path preserving trailing slash semantics

semantic_query: stripping content-type parameters like charset by stopping at first space or semicolon

semantic_query: splitting the Accept header into a slice of content types removing quality parameters

semantic_query: building base64-encoded Authorization header values for basic auth credential pairs

semantic_query: HTTP proxy basic authentication middleware that returns 407 on credential mismatch

semantic_query: XML request body decoding by creating an xml.Decoder and validating the result struct

semantic_query: YAML request body decoding using go-yaml NewDecoder and validating the bound struct
notes: Narrow regex — decodeYAML uses yaml.NewDecoder(r), Decode(obj), validate(obj); yamlBinding Name() returns "yaml" and implements BindingBody

semantic_query: TOML request body decoding using go-toml NewDecoder and validating the bound struct
notes: Narrow regex — decodeToml uses toml.NewDecoder(r), Decode(obj), validate(obj); tomlBinding Name() returns "toml" and implements BindingBody

semantic_query: mapping flat form values into a struct by the form struct tag using reflection

semantic_query: lazy-initializing the go-playground validator and validating any struct pointer or slice with binding tags

semantic_query: searching authorization credentials with constant-time byte comparison to prevent timing attacks

semantic_query: filtering the error list by type and serializing the error slice to JSON or a string

semantic_query: ANSI color methods for status code latency and HTTP method for terminal log output

semantic_query: HTML template instance creation for production pre-parsed templates and debug hot-reload templates

semantic_query: streaming an io.Reader body with Content-Length and custom extra headers to the response

semantic_query: issuing an HTTP redirect validating that the status code is in the 3xx range or 201

semantic_query: preventing JSON hijacking by prepending a security prefix to JSON array responses

semantic_query: escaping all non-ASCII unicode codepoints to \uXXXX sequences in JSON output

semantic_query: marshaling a struct to TOML and writing the result with application/toml content type

semantic_query: incrementing a child node priority and reordering the children to maintain priority ordering

semantic_query: filesystem wrapper that disables directory listing by neutralizing the Readdir method

semantic_query: collecting a formatted stack trace skipping N frames for panic recovery logging

semantic_query: computing the byte length of the longest common prefix between two path strings for trie insertion

semantic_query: counting colon and star path segments to determine the number of URL parameters in a route

semantic_query: creating an http.FileSystem optionally wrapping it in OnlyFilesFS to suppress directory listing
